kicker: 6 YEARS OF AB TRAINING IN 30 SECONDS
title: Why your *abs never show*

head: Most men train abs like this
r: Weighted cable crunches, heavier every week

label: THE FIX
head: 2 to 3 sessions, 10 to 15 hard sets
sub: Per week: cable crunches, hanging leg raises, ab wheel rollouts.

label: THE CATCH
head: You need roughly 10 to 14% body fat to see them
sub: Strong abs under a layer of fat still look flat.

text: Abs are built with weight. *Revealed by your diet.*

head: Add *weight* to your crunches
sub: Start with one heavy cable crunch set this week.
